notes: TaxiNodes native IDs are intended discovery keys; match to C_TaxiMap nodeID remains client-observation work. CharacterBitNumber is NOT nodeID (e.g.3203 hasbit1).
NativeFlags low bits agree exactly with pinned MapFlights faction ownership for every shared node; retained as factual faction mask1Alliance2Horde. Higher bits not interpreted.
Base cost is native TaxiPath.Cost; runtime GetTaxiCost may apply discounts or multi-hop sums.
Every native path retained, including excluded scripted/global/battleground paths; only eligible=true is normal flight inventory.
Estimated duration is heuristic; exact timing unavailable.
Approach coordinates retain master Z; manual-access-required records must not be converted to walking connectors.
